entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: fortunes, tls-renegotiation-kestrel, updates #67947
  • Perf regression: caching, single_query, updates #67946
  • Perf improvement: json, multiple_queries #67945
  • Add OpenApiOption property to disable OpenAPI XML documentation generation #67937
  • Virtualize doesn't render items for small `InitialIndex` until the first scroll #67933
    11.0.0

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #67948
  • Better error message for AntiforgeryValidationException: The provided antiforgery token was meant for a different claims-based user than the current user #63218
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Package conflicts between Microsoft.AspNetCore.Grpc.Swagger and Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi in .NET 10 #65228
  • Deprecate Microsoft.AspNetCore.Grpc.Swagger #67134
  • [Blazor] Improve authentification and usage of web apis (docs improvements) #61501
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Microsoft.OpenApi Deprecated Issue #67940
  • Update to the latest msal.js version #63688
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Fix scheme-relative behavior in Rewrite middleware #67812
  • Debugging Blazor Server app 'Edit and Continue' says 'Applying code updates' when no source changed #67895
  • ValidationContext passed to IsValid method of validation attributes always has root ValidatableType as the ObjectInstance #67004
    11.0-preview7
  • Remove DataAnnotations dependency in MEV public API #67550
  • Consider renaming `ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder` to `ConfigureWebApplicationBuilder` #67393
    11.0-preview7
  • Deprecate the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.DevServer package #67857
    11.0-preview7
  • [Blazor] Analyzer to warn about JSInterop calls not wrapped in a try catch block #67306
    Backlog
  • Dependency problem with Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi #67932
  • Auto-updates to Microsoft.OpenApi 3.0.0 don't work with .NET 10 #64317
    10.0.x
  • The `Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi` nuget package version 10.0.x nuget dependency to `Microsoft.OpenApi` v2.0.0 is incorrect and it should be constrained #67930

PullRequests

Created

  • [Infrastructure] Updated npm packages 2026-07-21 #67950
  • Update IdentityModelVersion to 8.19.2 #67949
  • Fix UseAuthorization failing without routing registered (#53332) #67944
    area-auth
  • Throw from client IInvocationBinder.GetParameterTypes when the target method does not exist #67939
  • Fix QuickGrid End-mode async-provider prepend viewport drift #67938
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix  InitialItemIndex viewport underfill for small indices #67936
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix Virtualize scroll jump from native/JS anchoring double-compensation #67934

Merged

  • [Kestrel] Deflake HTTP/2 connection closing tests #67789
    feature-kestrel, area-networking
  • Implement RFC 9931 §8 for HTTP/1.1 CONNECT in Kestrel #67929
    area-networking
  • Clear cached session key in cookie auth handler sign-out #67049
    area-auth
  • Improve antiforgery error message for unauthenticated requests with authenticated tokens #67942
    feature-antiforgery
  • Drop Microsoft.AspNetCore.Grpc.Swagger #67919
    area-grpc
  • Fix QuickGrid Start-mode async-provider prepend viewport drift. #67935
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #67828
  • Fix url normalizer backslashes #67928
    feature-rewrite-middleware, area-middleware
  • Fix QuickGrid None-mode async-provider prepend viewport drift #67931
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • Enable prepend/append detection with the default `ItemComparer` in `Virtualize<TItem>` #67905
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-preview7
  • Remove DataAnnotations' ValidationContext from MEV public API #67549
  • Rename ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder to ConfigureWebApplicationBuilder #67917
  • Expose InitialItemIndex parameter and ScrollToItemAsync method on QuickGrid  #67914
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • Deprecate the Blazor WebAssembly DevServer package #67862
  • Adding analyzer to warn about JSInterop calls not wrapped in a try catch block #67900
    community-contribution, 11.0-preview7
  • Delete dead code in DelegateOpenApiDocumentTransformer #67921

Updated

  • Harden SignalR stateful reconnect. #67409
  • Fix SignalR token retry for thrown 401 errors #67899
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Use schema examples for XML comment examples #67894
  • Harden SignalR `negotiateVersion` parsing. #67908
    area-signalr
  • Respect IModelNameProvider when matching OpenAPI parameters #64535
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal
  • fix: honor OpenAPI transformer registration order #67925
    community-contribution
  • feat: adds support for initializing the OpenAPI document for tag metadata in 3.2.0 #67457
    community-contribution
  • Handle passing a Func expression to Map* in ValidationsGenerator and RDG #67821
  • Blazor messes up standard HTMLTemplateElement <template> #67660
    community-contribution
  • Add OpenApiGenerateEnvironment property support for API description server document generation #63856
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Use ReadOnlyDictionary/ReadOnlyCollection for ValidateContext.ValidationErrors backing collections #67822
  • Fix validation for null nullable parameters in minimal APIs #67395
    community-contribution, area-minimal, feature-validation
